text: [Budgeting Discretion](project.html?id=modeling-discretion) was accepted to NeurIPS 2026 as a spotlight. I will be in Atlanta in December.
I defended my dissertation proposal and am now a PhD candidate.
[Can LLMs Rank?](project.html?id=can-llms-rank) was accepted to AIES 2026 in Malmö, Sweden.
New preprint: [Can LLMs Rank?](project.html?id=can-llms-rank) pairs a circular-triad check with inter-run agreement to test whether an LLM's rankings can be trusted.
I presented [Fixed Points and Stochastic Meritocracies](project.html?id=stochastic-merit) at FAccT 2026 in Montreal.
I joined Pearson as an intern on the Scoring Services team, working on evaluation methods for model-assisted scoring.
[Fixed Points and Stochastic Meritocracies](project.html?id=stochastic-merit) was accepted to FAccT 2026.
New preprint: [Budgeting Discretion](project.html?id=modeling-discretion) models discretion as a budgeted resource.
